title: Schedule of Charges for Payment Arrangements: Setup Fee, Interest, Late Charges and Early Payoff
content:
**Schedule of Charges — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**

| Tier | Arrangement fee (billed with the first installment) | Interest on the arranged balance | Late charges on the unbilled arranged balance | Ordinary late charge on a billed installment unpaid past due | Early payoff allowed | Early payoff fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | $0.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | $0.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | $0.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | $0.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | $0.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | $25.00 | 0 percent per year | no | yes | yes | $0.00 |

**Explanatory notes**

1. The *arrangement fee* is the fee, in US dollars, to set up the agreement, billed with the first installment. Only the Commercial Installment Agreement carries one, $25.00.
2. *Interest* is the interest charged on the arranged balance, in percent per year; every tier charges 0 percent.
3. *Late charges on the unbilled arranged balance*: no tier accrues late charges on the part of the arranged balance not yet billed back as installments.
4. *Late charge on a missed installment*: on every tier a billed installment left unpaid past due is subject to the ordinary late charge.
5. *Early payoff*: every tier allows the member to pay the remaining arranged balance at any time, and no tier charges a fee for doing so.

**Illustration (hypothetical)** — a member's first Commercial Installment Agreement bill carries the first installment and the $25.00 arrangement fee; a first installment bill under any other tier carries no arrangement fee.
